---
title: "Excel dashboard"

::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?** [📈]{.excel-menu .red} (**Dashboard**).
:::

The dashboard shows **hourly energy flows** and storage states. A common time window lets you examine demand, supply and storage response together. The [Python scenario explorer](dashboard.qmd) is a separate application.

::: {.excel-path}
**Ribbon:** klimaaktiv PEQ → Ergebnisse → [Dashboard]{.excel-action}
:::

## Selecting a period and hourly profiles

::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?**

1. Select a period under [Datum auswählen]{.excel-action}; use the timeline for contiguous ranges.
2. Choose a manageable window, such as one week. **TAGE** in the screenshot sets the date window; it is not itself evidence of hourly aggregation.
3. Check chart time axes: hourly profiles must show timestamps within days.
4. After recalculation, use [Aktualisieren]{.excel-action} (refresh) so pivot views adopt the new results.
:::

![Period selection and refresh above the dynamic charts. Hourly timestamps in the January/February window accompany electricity demand, supply and storage states.](../media/manual/excel-dashboard.png){.manual-figure}

## Electricity demand and use

The top chart shows user electricity, inflexible building-services demand, EV charging and additional flexible use. Read storage charging as a separate contribution. Compare power-profile peaks with enabled periods and storage states.

## Electricity supply

The second chart distinguishes conventional and flexible imports, PV use, battery withdrawal, EV discharge and PV feed-in. Use each legend to identify simultaneous contributions; respect signs and boundaries.

## Room temperature and thermal building mass

Temperatures of cooled and uncooled areas show thermal response. Check flexible preconditioning against setpoints and permitted temperature bands. Temperature is a state indicator, not stored energy in kWh.

## Hot-water storage

States of hot-water systems 1 and 2 show charging and use during the selected period. Read percentages according to the chart scale; do not interpret them as temperature or absolute storage capacity.

## EVs and battery

**EV-SoC** shows charge levels by use; **Batterie-SoC** shows stationary storage. Assess minimum charge, flexible charging and discharging alongside electricity flows.

## Thermal daily averages and further views

Heat gains and losses of the two thermally decoupled zones are also evaluated as daily averages. Daily averages and hourly power are different aggregations.

![Model and dashboard: thermally decoupled zones, heat balance and daily-average heat flows. The lower chart explicitly shows daily means.](../media/manual/thermal-model.png){.manual-figure}
